description:
Activate Freed from the Real's first ability by paying {U}, tapping Kilo.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate twice due to Tekuthal, thus putting two +1/+1 counters on Berta.
Berta triggers twice, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Kilo.
Repeat.
